01:53 How does the Holy Spirit’s work compare to that of angels?

17:02 Does Romans 9:14-23 teach predestination? If God shows no partiality (Romans 2:11), why does He "harden" hearts?

📖 "I'd Like to Know" | Bible Q&A with Seventh-day Adventist Pastors | SUMtv
Welcome to I’d Like to Know, a Bible Q&A program on SUMtv featuring Seventh-day Adventist pastors, including Pastor Stephen Bohr, President of SUMtv. Each episode explores Scripture to provide clear, biblically-based answers to your questions, offering spiritual guidance and practical wisdom. Tune in for insights to deepen your understanding of God’s Word!

Send us your questions at tv@sumtv.org, and they might be featured in our upcoming Q&A episode! 🙏✨

⏰ Join Us Live Every Tuesday at 4:30 PM (Pacific Time)
Tune in to SUMtv.org for our live studio Q&A, where we dive into the Word of God to answer your questions!

Explore in-depth Bible studies and spiritual resources at SecretsUnsealed.org.
